section: Revolutionary nationalism - first phase: Anushilan Samiti, Yugantar, Alipore and Kakori-era cases, Savarkar

accepted.s: The revolutionary activities of the first phase of revolutionary nationalism assumed greater significance primarily because they:
o: established a broad-based Hindu-Muslim mass movement
ended the policy of revolutionary violence after the Surat Split
replaced constitutional agitation with participation in legislative councils
kept radical nationalism alive through individual heroic actions after the decline of mass Swadeshi
accepted.x: Individual heroic actions, including assassinations and ‘Swadeshi dacoities’, kept radical nationalism alive after the Surat Split and the failure of mass Swadeshi.
accepted.tq: Identify the central significance rather than an exaggerated consequence.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the limitations of the first phase of revolutionary nationalism:
1. It did not develop into a mass movement.
2. Its strong Hindu-revivalist symbolism restricted Muslim participation.
3. The worship of Bhavani was one expression of this symbolism.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Revolutionary nationalism remained limited as a mass movement, and its Hindu-revivalist imagery, including the worship of Bhavani, restricted Muslim participation.
accepted.tq: Check each statement against the movement’s character and limitations.

accepted.s: With reference to the Tenali Bomb Case, which one of the following statements is correct?
o: It occurred on 6 April 1909 and involved an attempt to plant bombs for the Howrah Express near Tenali.
It occurred in February 1909 and concerned an attack on a police station at Rampa.
It occurred after the Non-Cooperation Movement and involved the Kakori train.
It occurred in 1913 and involved the Ghadar Party’s attack on a railway station.
accepted.x: The Tenali Bomb Case took place on 6 April 1909, when bombs were planted for the Howrah Express near Tenali.
accepted.tq: Use the exact date, place and target to distinguish closely related revolutionary cases.

accepted.s:
In the Tenali Bomb Case, which of the following were transported, according to the account of the case?
1. Chukkapalli Ramayya
2. Lakkaraju Basavayya
3. Tanguturi Prakasam

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Chukkapalli Ramayya and Lakkaraju Basavayya were transported. Tanguturi Prakasam defended them and was not one of those transported.
accepted.tq: Separate the accused from the person who defended them.

accepted.s: The Kotappakonda incident of February 1909 is associated with which one of the following statements?
o: The Kakori train action was organised by the Hindustan Republican Association.
Chinnappa Reddy received the only death sentence of the Vandemataram movement.
Tanguturi Prakasam defended the accused in the Tenali Bomb Case.
A bomb was thrown at Viceroy Hardinge during his state entry into Delhi.
accepted.x: Kotappakonda, in Guntur, witnessed the case of Chinnappa Reddy, who received the only death sentence of the Vandemataram movement.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly matches the place and date associated with the Kotappakonda episode?
accepted.x: The Kotappakonda episode occurred in February 1909. Kotappakonda is in Guntur, whereas Tenali was associated with the Bomb Case of 6 April 1909.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the two closely timed revolutionary episodes in Andhra.

accepted.s: Which one of the following current-affairs associations is correctly matched?
o: Canada’s apology for Komagata Maru — 2 May 1916
accepted.x: The notes associate the tribute to Azad’s birth anniversary with 23 July 2026. The other dates are incorrect: Canada’s apology is dated 2 May 2026, the profiles are from March 2026, and the Thai-Bharat reference is dated 15 June 2026.
accepted.tq: Reject altered dates by matching each current reference with its precise year and day.

accepted.s: The Canadian Prime Minister’s apology relating to the Komagata Maru was made in which forum, according to the cited current reference?
accepted.x: The apology relating to the Komagata Maru was made by Canada’s Prime Minister Justin Trudeau in the House of Commons in 2016.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact institutional forum instead of the country alone.

accepted.s: The profiles of Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev and Rajguru were highlighted in which period mentioned in the current references?
accepted.x: The profiles of Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev and Rajguru were cited as a March 2026 reference.
accepted.tq: Distinguish nearby months in date-based current-affairs questions.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the connection of Giani Pritam Singh with the origins of the Indian Independence League (IIL)?
o: He was associated with the Tenali Bomb Case, and the IIL originated in Guntur.
He was a Ghadar veteran, and the Bangkok Thai-Bharat Cultural Lodge was associated with the IIL’s origins.
He was a leader of the Anushilan Samiti, and the IIL originated in Alipore.
He led the Kakori action, and the IIL originated in Muzaffarpur.
accepted.x: Giani Pritam Singh is identified as a Ghadar veteran, and Bangkok’s Thai-Bharat Cultural Lodge is linked with the origins of the IIL.
accepted.tq: Use the person–organisation–place association to eliminate swapped revolutionary connections.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements correctly reflects the relationship of Alluri Sitarama Raju with the Indian National Congress and the Non-Cooperation Movement?
o: He founded the Indian National Congress and opposed all armed resistance.
He was a member of the Ghadar Party and organised the Komagata Maru voyage.
He was not linked to the Indian National Congress, but his struggle troubled the British more than the Non-Cooperation Movement.
He was formally linked to the Indian National Congress and led the Non-Cooperation Movement in Andhra.
accepted.x: Alluri Sitarama Raju was not linked to the Indian National Congress; nevertheless, his armed struggle troubled the British more than the Non-Cooperation Movement.
accepted.tq: Test the contrast between formal Congress association and the impact of the armed struggle.
